en.headline: Hiker collapses on Kau Yi Chau, airlifted by helicopter
en.dek: A man in his 30s lost consciousness while hiking on the outlying island on Saturday afternoon; Government Flying Service crews lifted him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.
body: A man in his thirties collapsed while hiking on Kau Yi Chau in Sai Kung on Saturday afternoon and was airlifted to hospital by the Government Flying Service.

Police said a group of hikers had been on the island when the man, surnamed Chan and aged about 30, suddenly felt unwell and later lost consciousness. Companions called for help shortly after 1 pm. Because the location is an outlying island with limited road access, a Government Flying Service helicopter was scrambled and the casualty was winched aboard and flown to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.
The case has been classified as a person collapsing. The man’s condition and the precise cause of the incident remain under investigation.

zh.headline: 西貢娥眉洲男子行山暈倒 直升機送院
zh.dek: 一名約30歲男子周六下午在娥眉洲行山期間突然不適並陷入昏迷，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他送往東區醫院治理。
body: 西貢娥眉洲周六下午發生行山人士暈倒事件，一名約30歲姓陳男子由政府飛行服務隊直升機送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院治理。
警方表示，事發時一行人正在娥眉洲郊遊，陳男突然感到不適其後陷入昏迷，同行友人報案求助。由於事發地點屬離島，地面救援困難，政府飛行服務隊接報派出直升機到場，將事主吊上機艙後送往東區醫院。
案件列作有人暈倒處理，事主情況及事發原因仍有待調查。
